touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Towyn qualifies as a local detour through Knightly's Fun Park and Church of St Mary, with churchyard walls. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Towyn: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Towyn offers Knightly's Fun Park, Church of St Mary, with churchyard walls, Catholic Church of Christ the King within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Knightly's Fun Park
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Knightly's Fun Park and Church of St Mary, with churchyard walls, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
